entry.title: About Me
entry.content:
I am a Master of Public Relations & Advertising graduate from UNSW Sydney with experience in advertising, public relations, digital marketing, campaign planning and stakeholder engagement.

Throughout my academic projects and professional experience, I have developed integrated marketing campaigns, PR strategies and digital content for brands and organisations across different industries. I enjoy transforming research and consumer insights into creative ideas that create meaningful engagement.

I am passionate about strategic communication, brand storytelling and data-driven marketing, and I am currently seeking graduate opportunities in Marketing, Public Relations and Advertising.
